tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: bde chen zhing gi ro sreg cho ga ngan song gnas 'dren sdug bsngal mtsho skem gtan bde rab 'bar bzhugs so//

na mo a mi tā bhā ya / dbang med bar do'i sems can rnams// rigs drug skye sgo gcod pa'i phyir// byang chog ltar du phyir ldog bya// 'od dpag med pa'i gzungs ring de// phreng re byas pa tshar gsum bri// de gsum mjug tu sham bu gsum// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ bris pa phung po'i spyi bor btags// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: yig drug bris pa dpung pa g.yas// oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ: zhes pa bris pa dpung pa g.yon// de yis gnas yig mdor bsdus tshang*// de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las// sa sel nyes pa thams cad ni// gal te dbyung bar mi nus na// lag pas reg la sngags bzlas bya// de nyid dag pa mchog tu 'gyur// gsus phyir de ru sa mi rko// rdo leb shing lo rtsa sngo sogs// bkod steng gzhan nas sa blang bcag / oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa bzlas shing lag pas bcag /de steng dkar gtor gcig bshams te/ a kā ro yis byin gyis brlab// rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs kyis// 'od dpag med pa'i skur gsal ba'i// phyag g.yas sa la gdab pa yis// sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos// sa de'i dkyil nas lha mo ni// gser mdog dar dang ratnas brgyan// khas len phyag rgya gter bum 'dzin// sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sa lam bgrod pa'i dbang po mo// snang zhing srid pa'i sa bdag dang*// 'dir gnas sa yi bdag po rnams// 'dir gshegs sa glud gtor ma bzhes// sa 'di bdag la gnang mdzod la// 'di ru ma gnas gzhan du bzur// oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ arghaṃ sogs/ sa yi lha mo dga' zhing 'dzum// sa 'di gnang gis 'gro don spyod// ces gsungs sa la thim gyur pas// sa yang gser gyi phung por gyur*// sa bdag gzhan rnams rang gnas byer// sarba bhū mi pa ti gatstsha/

de nas thig tshon so sor bsham/ rin chen snod du thig tshon rnams// oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā rnams las// rang mdog rigs lnga'i skur gyur cing*// ye shes sa thim 'od du zhu// oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ bdun re brjod pas byin brlabs te// de nas thig chen brgyad btab la// theb srin sbyar bas skud sne 'dzin// gru mo'i rtse ru tshad byas la// de nyid blteb nas dbus su bzung*// zlum por bskor ba theb kyi rgya// de yi phyi rim sor bzhi pa// gnyis dang sor rdo pa gnyis bskor// mchu dang kha khyer kha bad dang*// kha 'phyang bzhi ru 'byung ba yin// bsdu na gnyis sam gcig gis chog /dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi// lte bar rdo rje dkar po bri// 'dab brgyad phyogs mdog mdzes tshon te// phyi rol kha khyer rdo rje dkar// de rgyab gzhi ni dkar po la// sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu bri// de rgyab ljang gu rin chen ser// de rgyab ser po padma dmar// zur bzhi zla phyed rdo rje bzhi// dril bu 'khrol zhing spyan gyis gzigs// bskor ba byas te zhal khebs rgyab// de steng gdung khang brtsegs pa'am// phal par shing sdong gru bzhir brtsegs// spur gdan shog bur 'dab brgyad bri// spur bzhag spur khebs shog bu la// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris pas bkab// nye logs sam ni gzhan du'ang rung*// sreg gdan gzhi ni dkar po'i steng*// g.yas su bsreg rdzas thams cad dang*// g.yon du mchod pa sna bdun dang*// me lha'i gtor ma che chung gnyis// zlum po rgyan can li sder gang*// chos skyong gtor ma zur gsum gcig /mdun du me lha mchod pa yi// mchod pa sna bdun cha tshang dang*// mar khu dgang gzar kha sbyar bsham// las bum nang du dran rdzogs su// rta mgrin bsgom la sngags bzlas bzhag /yam shing sor mo bcu gnyis pa// ku sha dpal 'bar la sogs pa// nyer mkho'i yo byad tshang bar byas// zhing sgrub las byang sngon song rjes// rang nyid 'od dpag med du bsgom// mchod pa spur khang bcas pa bran//

oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi// gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin// sman gtor bsreg rdzas sna tshogs pa// zad med gyur cig pū dzaḥhoḥ rdor dril dang bcas dgang blugs sbyar// rdzas rnams kun la reg bya zhing*// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ de nas rdzas rnams bkru bsam zhing*/ oṃ swā hā/ yam shing la reg / oṃ shriṃ swā hā/ mar khu la reg / oṃ āḥswā hā/ 'bru thams cad la reg /oṃ dzriṃ swā hā/ thams cad la reg / oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ las bum ku sha dpal 'bar gsum// rlung g.yab me dar dang bcas bzung*// rgyan gos dang bcas spur khang bskor// ku sha bsangs sbyangs byas nas kyang*// oṃ las ku sha sngo ljang ni// srung ba'i nus pa phun tshogs gyur// oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ pad skor dang bcas gnyis re blang*/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gis bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi zhing bde legs mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra satwa āḥ thabs kyi kha khyer g.yas bskor bkod// chun po gnyis ni rgya gram bcings// rtse mo tshur bstan dbus su bzhag /las bum gyis bran bsangs sbyangs te// stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las// zhi ba'i thabs khung mtshan nyid ldan// bud shing rnams kyis gang ba'i dbus// padma dang ni zla ba'i steng*// raṃ las me lha sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi drang song gzugs// spyan gsum ral pa'i thor tshugs can// g.yas gnyis dbyu gu skyabs sbyin phyag /g.yon gnyis phreng ba ril ba 'dzin// ra skyes gdan la phyed skyil bzhugs// 'od 'bar me lce stong gis dkris// de yi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ// thugs dbus raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las rdzas 'di rnams// oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a rnams las// rigs lnga'i ngo bo ye shes kyi// kha dog lnga ldan me 'bar gyur/

/dril bu 'khrol zhing dbyangs dang bcas// de nas me spar ba ni/ hūṃ me 'di'i rtsa ba sngo ba de// rdo rje sems pa'i ye shes me// de steng me mdog dmar ba de// snang ba mtha' yas ye shes me// me 'di'i sked pa ser ba de// rin chen 'byung ldan ye shes me// de steng me mdog dkar ba de// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes me// me 'di'i rtse mo nag pa de// don yon grub pa'i ye shes me// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me yin no// ye shes lnga'i me dpung gis// khyod kyi phung po lnga sbyangs pas// dug lnga gtan nas dag nas kyang*// ye shes sku lnga thob par shog /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ me 'bar gyer la me ru btsug / oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ: hūṃ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba 'di// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og tu// ma 'phro ma mched ma khyil cig /lha srin kun la gnod dogs pas// me mgo dar gyis mnan par bya// oṃ me dpal shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod me dar g.yab byas la// mgyogs par bzhi 'gram 'ong nas 'dug /phyogs gtsang lnga ser med phyogs su// kha gyus bsreg rdzas thams cad ni// mchod g.yog pa la bskur bas chog / thab tu gnas pa'i me lha yi// thugs las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// shar lho phyogs las me yi lha// drang srong tshogs bcas spyan drangs gyur// lag g.yas mi 'jigs phyag rgya yi// mthe bong srin lag rtsar g.yab cing*// rna ba g.yon nas g.yas ngos khyer// g.yon pas dril bu bsil bya zhing*// oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dza: hūṃ gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab bsgrub pa// thugs rjes sems can don gyi phyir// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol// oṃ agni de wa sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan// thab kyi shar lho ku sa'i gdan// ye shes me lha 'khor bcas 'khod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri ba wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/

pā dyaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ zhes pas chu gnyis 'bul byas te// lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i// mthe bong gis ni the'u chung mnan// dam tshig phyag rgya de phyar zhing*// hūṃ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyi// dam tshig la ni gnas na ni// rigs rnams myur du thal bar byed// oṃ ha na sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa: ye shes me lha dam tshig pa// dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par gyur// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// rigs lnga spyan drangs dbang skur te// sku gang chu lhag yar lud pas// rnam par snang mdzad dbu rgyan gyur// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar/ oṃ gzi brjid ldan pa me yi lha// 'bar byed sku yi rgyan gyis rgyan// rngam pa'i byin can las la brtson// sreg blugs 'bul lo las kun sgrubs// tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// zhi la sogs pa'i lha dpal te// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i// gzi brjid rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// dgang blugs kha la hrīḥyig dang*// me lha cung zad zhal gdangs pa'i// ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan pas// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir bzhes par gyur/ /lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i// khu 'tshur mdzub mo gnyis bur ka yang pas// dgang blugs bzung ste dgang gzar gyis// blugs gzar nang du mar khu ni// sngags re brjod cing lan bdun blugs// oṃ agna ye swā hā/ gru mo gnyis po pus mo las// phyir mi 'da' bar dgang blugs sbyor// thab kyi kha la g.yas bskor ni// lan gsum byas par bsgom bya zhing*// oṃ agna ye ha bya ka bya wā ha nā ya ā di bya swā hā/ zhes pas mar khu skyogs su blug / de 'dra gsum mam bdun gyis bskur// dud po sngon po gyen 'greng dang*// me lce dkar dang gyen du 'bar// dri ngan med sogs bzang rtags te// me lce nag dang du ba tshub// ngan pa'i rtags mtshan byung gyur na// rta mgrin sngags ni mang du bzlas// las bum chu yis bran bcug go

/ me lha'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// tshe 'das bkug nas sdig sgrib rnams// 'od zer gyis drangs bsreg rdzas la// thim ste me lhas gsol bar gyur// gang zag bzang po yin na ni// sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib bstim// bsreg rdzas gung mtheb sbyar bas 'bul// bsregs rdzas kun gyi sngags mgo la// oṃ agna ye dhe wa zhes sbyar yam shing byang chub shing*// bsam la rtse mo steng bstan 'bul// oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ tshe las 'das bdag gzhan sems can gyi sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ thams cad la 'gre/ pa'i skye ba gzhan du 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sogs/ til nag la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= yungs dkar la/ oṃ sarba artha sid dha ye swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i bar do'i 'jigs skrag thams cad= zas mchog ni skya tshul mar sogs zas sna bsreg / oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= durwani ram rtsi yin te/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i zhing khams bgrod pa la myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma re swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= so ba la/ oṃ badzra bī dza ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad=

sran ma la/ oṃ badzra ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ tshe las 'das pa'i srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= bil ba ltar kha 'am ma rnyed na se thag shug thog gang rung la/ oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya swāhā/ tshe las 'das pa'i rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= dkar gsum mngar gsum gang 'byor la/ oṃ badzra mā le puṣṭa ye swāhā/ tshe las 'das pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= me tog dkar po med na nas la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe swā hā/ tshe las skye ba gzhan du kha dog dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= dri dang so rtsi ja sogs btung ba'i rigs la/ oṃ badzra taṃ bu lā ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad= sman sna tshogs la/ oṃ oṣa dhi swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i= dar ras gos sna dum bu la/ oṃ badzra wast+rā ya swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa'i skye ba gzhan du rgyan dang gos phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i= 'dir ma 'thus pa'i 'bru'i rigs/ bza' btung la sogs 'bul 'dod na/ oṃ agna ye sogs lha sngags 'jug tu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ltar til ni nyer gcig tsam/ gzhan rnams bdun nam gsum res mchog /de nas rang mdun mchod pa rnams// re re bzhin du 'bul bar bya// 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/

'jig rten khams ni= zhabs bsil ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ= 'jig rten khams ni= me tog ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ya sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe= 'jig rten khams ni= bdug spos ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā dhū pe= 'jig rten khams ni= snang gsal ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke= 'jig rten khams ni= dri chab ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra gandhe= 'jig rten khams ni= zhal zas ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= drang srong me lha'i= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ni wi dya= 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥ hūṃ/

mchod pa rnams dang mar me dang*// lha bshos la sogs 'bul bya zhing*// rol mo'i skabs su mtshams 'dzin gyi// me tog 'thor zhing dril bu bsil// spro na rol chen 'ur brdung bya// oṃ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la bskyabs pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa'i// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /phrin las grub pa'i mnga' bdag che// bskal pa'i me lhar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi theg mchog ra skyes chibs// bgrang phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung*// bdud rtsi'i bcud bkang gundhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang*// sa lam bar chad zhi bar mdzod// drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon gyi dam bcas mna' dor ba// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg gi ni me la gnas// me lha khyed nyid me dpung dang*// gnyis su med par bzhugs mdzod la// sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di rnams kun// bde chen zhing gi lha tshogs kyi// zhal du bstab pa'i las mdzod cig /me lha'i thugs las sprul pa yi// me lha drang srong yid las skyes// rang 'dra zhig gis lha tshogs la// mchod pa'i phyag gtsang mdzad par gyur// me lha'i lto ba rgya che ba// 'od las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*// de dbus padma zla gdan la// 'od dpag me mgon sku mdog dmar/ /zhes pa nas/ ba lingta rakta khā hi 'i bar/ zhing sgrub cho ga bzhin du 'don// phal pa yin na sreg rdzas rnams// tshe 'das sha rus dbyer med bsgom// lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa yin// gang zag dam pa'i gdung yin na// gdung dang lha tshogs dbyer med bsgom// sreg rdzas mchod pa 'bul ba ni//

oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ de la gong gi sreg rdzas sngags// btags te rim par 'bul ba ste// lha sngags rdzas sngags 'dod gsol gsum// gcig tu brtsi ba grangs su 'dzin// gtso bo la ni brgya re 'bul/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ de la rdzas sngags btags byas te// thugs rje chen por nyer gcig 'bul// oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ/ mthu chen thob la nyer gcig 'bul// oṃ sarba buddha bho dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra la bde chen zhing gi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la// bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul// 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ 'jig khams ni= zhabs bsil ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= bcom ldan 'khor dang= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra ti tstsha la sogs 'gre'o// 'jig rten khams ni= me tog ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= bcom ldan 'khor dang= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra puṣpe= 'jig rten khams ni= bdug spos ji snyed= bdag gis gus= bcom ldan= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra dhu pe= 'jig rten khams ni= snang gsal ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= bcom ldan 'khor= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra a lo ke= 'jig rten khams ni= dri chab ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= bcom ldan 'khor= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra gandhe= 'jig rten khams ni= zhal zas ji snyed= bdag gis gus pas= bcom ldan 'khor= bzhes nas zhi ba'i= oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wa ra nai wi dya pra ti= 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wa ra shapta pra ti tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/

bar gyis rgyas par mchod/ me lha'i gtor ma che ba de// mar khu dran la bkyags bcug la// a ka ra ོsa byin brlabs la// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul byas nas// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyug 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// tshig 'jug der yod thams cad kyis// rjes zlos lan gsum byed bcug la// gdung khang nang du phul bcug go / oṃ rdo rje sku ni sku zhes sogs nas/ badzra satwa hūṃ gi bar/ cho ga'i nang ltar brjod par bya// de nas chos skyong gtor ma bran// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// zhing skyong yab yum spyan drangs la// me lha'i lto ba bde chen zhing*// phyag rdor drung der bzhugs par bsgom// snang ba mtha' yas bka' srung ba// zhes pa nas/ rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bkang*// sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes// argha ཾ la sogs sngags kyis mchod// oṃ si haṃ mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si na ra ma hūṃ phaṭa/ tri hring dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa/ tri hrīng dzaḥ de la rdzas sngags btags nas kyang*// bsreg rdzas thams bdun re 'bul// hūṃ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// khas blang sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*// mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// zhing skyong 'khor bcas bdag gis bstod// dam rdzas sbyin bsreg mchod pa bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang*// gang bcol las rnams grub par mdzod//

de nas gtor mar mar khu bran// na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs sogs dus/ bdag cag yon mchod zhes pa dang*// tshe 'das bde chen zhing khams su// zhes sogs 'gug gzhug tshig zur bsgyur// hūṃ dpal ldan zhing skyong gtor ma bzhes// tshe 'das bde chen zhing khams su// sngon nas bsus la phyi nas skyol// sa dang lam gyi bar chad zlog /gson po tshe dang ldan rnams kyis// nad gdon bar chad thams cad sol// bkra shis bde legs 'grub par mdzod// gtor ma thab tu 'bul rgyu bskur// de nas rgyas par spro na ni// me lha'i thugs kar bde chen zhing*// de mthar tshe 'das bskyed byas la// byang chog bzhin du phyir ldog bya// bsdu na lha bskyed nas bzung ste// bum dbang bar du byang chog ltar// de nas zas bsngo byang chog ltar// zas rnams thabs kyi nang du 'bul// me sbar mi dgos sngar byas chog /lam bstan bsngo ba byang chog ltar// de yis sbyin sreg dngos gzhi rdzogs// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra de la bsreg rdzas sngags sbyar ba// bdun re gong ltar phul bar bya// de la arghaṃ sogs btags la/ mchod pa rnams kyang cha re 'bul/ hūṃ bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// sems can rnams la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs// dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mdzad pa// snang mtha' mnyam bzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod do// ma 'byor ba dang mnyam pa dang*// gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes byas gang*// de dag ma lus bzod par gsol// zhes sogs yig brgya tshar re bzlas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang gnas gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim//

de nas sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams// grangs ka mi bzur lhag med du// gong ltar 'jig rten me lhar 'bul// me lha'i gtor mar mar khu bran// g.yon ngos sbyin bdag de yis bkyags// a kā ro yis byin gyis brlabs// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis bsngo byas te// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// 'dod gsol yon bdag rjes zlos bcug /me lha'i sngags dang argha ཾ sogs// btags la mchod pa lhag med 'bul// 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyis sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// nas/ de kun drang srong bzod par mdzod// yig rgya bzlas/ ba dag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar byon te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ a gna ye sa pa ri wā ra badzra muḥ ye shes me lha shar lhor gshegs// dam tshig 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur// spyan drangs pa yi phyag rgya yi// mthe bong phyir la bskyed par bya// bsngo ba smon lam bya ba dang*// ye ge brgya pa tshar gsum 'don// dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po brjod// de nas ngag btang rdor dril bzhag / oṃ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod rus pa thal sol bsdu// gang zag bzang po'i thal sol ni// chu chen gzhung du btab byas pas// chu 'thung sems can sgrib pa sbyong*// phal pa'i thal sol klu med cing*// sa dpal bzang sar blug tu bcug

/rus pa snod gtsang nang du bzhag /de la khrus dang phyir ldog bya// de ni rus chog zhes bya'o// mdun du dkar gtor gcig bshams la// sa slong skabs su bshad pa yi// dmigs pa dang bcas sa lha la// gtor ma bsngo la 'bul rgyu bskur// sa skyin blang bcug mdun du spungs// a rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su// 'od dpag med pa'i sku gsal ba'i// thugs las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rgyud bskul// sku las 'od 'phros sa la thim// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyur// oṃ bhrūṃ swā hā/ nyer gcig brjod/ lag thig gnyis su a yig las// zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig las// rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa// de zhu lag par thim pa yis// lag pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang// sor mo rdo rje rtse gcig gyur// oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ tshe 'das de yi slob ma dang*// nye 'brel min cing sdig chen smin// de 'dra zhig gis rus pa btul// chus spyod phu ron dngas ru tsam// de yis sa sprus 'jim pa bya// las bum chu yis bran bya zhing*// rta mgrin bsngags bzlas mi gtsang bsangs// swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs// bhrūṃ las rin chen phung por gyur// mthe bong gnyis kyis mdzub chung mnan// lag gnyis kha sprod tshul byas la// lan grangs nyer gcig 'jim par reg /'od dpag gzungs ring nyer gcig brjod// lag pas 'jim pa skur phor reg / chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las// gzugs sku sna tshogs byon par gyur// oṃ dharma dhā tu garbhe swā hā/ de yis rus chog cho ga tshar// de nas mi mang thams cad kyis// oṃ bhūṃ swā hā/ yig drug gnyis// gang 'dod bzlas shing btab pas chog /skam nas dkar rtsi gsol grub legs// dkar rtsi med kyang 'gal ba med// de nas sā tstsha thams cad bsgrigs// mar me mchod pa bshams byas la// swa bhā wa yi sngags brjod nas//

stong pa'i ngang las mchod rten ni// chen po mang po gyur pa yi// bum pa'i nang du rin chen gyi// gzhal yas khang pa rgya chen gyi// dbus su padma zla gdan la// 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar// zhes pa nas bzung 'od chog ni// tshe 'gugs ma gtogs thams cad 'don// de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das// 'od zhu mchod rten rnam par gyur// rten 'brel snying po nyer gcig ni// brjod cing nas 'thor rab gnas so// gang zag bral ba'i rus tsha ni// chu thung bskor ba mi 'gro zhing*// sa dgra med pa'i phug par bskyal// gnas bdag de la dkar gtor bsngo// rang gi chos 'brel zhus pa'am// rang gi nyid du yin na ni// rang gi me ni mi sbar ba// grwa pa zhig la spar du bcug /tha mal phung po me sbar ba// nyes pa yod ces la las smra// me sbar mkhan cig gla sbyin tshol// tshe 'das de'i ming nas 'bod// me thal bros zhes brjod pa ni// bla de ro la gnas pa'i phyir// de la skrag snang 'byung dogs zer// de 'dra log pa yin pa'i phyir// de 'dra'i mig ltos mi bya bar// me ni slob dpon rang gis sbar// gang dag bzang po'i gdung la ni// de yi yi dam gang yin bskyed// mchod bstod byas la gshegs su gsol// gdung de dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed// de la mchod bstod byas la bzhu// de ma byas na bla ma'i gdung*// gser sku bshig dang 'dra'o zer// 'on kyang de byas rten mi 'byon// gdung dang yi dam dbyer med la// sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul ba yin// de la nyes pa 'byung mi srid// gang zag bzang po'i gdung la ni// gdung khang steng du am bcings khar// byin rlabs can gyi rten gcig bzhag /de ma byas na ring bsrel sogs// rten rnams mkha' 'gros gdan 'dren srid// de dag zhal gdams nye mkho yin// 'od chog ro sreg rung ba'i don// 'od dpag tshe dpag don gcig cing*// spyod rgyud tshe dpag gsung dkyil skabs// lha yi bu rnams zhi ba yi// hom khung tha ma bar ma mchog

/khru gang khru do khru bzhi pa'i// zlum po nyid du byas na ni// de yi ming la yung dkar gyi// brgya phrag stong du bsregs byas na// ngan song kun las thar bar 'gyur// de yi sha dang rus pa dang*// skra dang thal ba la sogs pas// cho ga de dag 'dra bar ni// sbyin sreg byas na ngan song yang*// kun las rnam par thar bar gyur// zhes gsungs gsang 'dus rgyud las kyang*// rnam shes lnga bral bem po'i lus// bag chags sbyangs pas thar pa thob// sbyong gzhi phyi dang nang gi ro// sbyong byed 'byung ba ye shes me// 'byung ba'i me yis bag chags sbyong// ye shes me yis nyon mongs sreg /zhes gsungs phyir na phan yon che// rang ngam sbyin bdag gson po yis// so sen skra dang gos rnying la// sgrib sbyong sbyin sreg blugs 'dod na// bya tshul thams cad gong dang 'dra// tshe 'das zhes par tshe ldan bsgyur// phyir zlog 'dod yon bsngo ba bsgyur// de yi tshab la tshe 'gugs sbyor// zhing skyong 'gug gzhug gtor 'bul mjug /las dang gzhung gi de ltar 'don// sā tstsha sogs kyang grub na legs// bla ma sman bla khu dbon gyis// ring nas bskul ba don yod phyir// dge slong rā ga asya yis// lcags mo phag lo'i dbo zla yi// tshes pa bcu gnyis bcu gsum gyi// thun skabs 'gal la smras

"$ pa ltar// nam mkha' kun dga' gnyis po yis// res mos byas shing bris pa la// nyes 'ga' gang mchis lha la bshags// dge bas skye 'gro mang po zhig /rigs drug skye sgo chod nas kyang*// bde chen zhing du skye bar shog// /
